# synology_network_proxy (Resource)

Outbound DSM HTTP/HTTPS proxy policy. The password is write-only and changes only with an increased version after import. Read, import and destroy never change the proxy. Existing credentials are retained when omitted; unreadable password drift cannot be detected.

## Adopt existing settings

Use an initialized project from [Check the NAS connection](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/elephant-evergreen/synology/latest/docs#check-the-nas-connection). Add this import block with your resource address and the ID of the existing DSM object.

```terraform
import {
  to = synology_network_proxy.nas
  id = "network_proxy"
}
```

1. Add the resource block with the values DSM currently reports. Use the sample configuration as a starting point.
2. Run `terraform plan -out=adopt.tfplan`. For one import, expect `1 to import, 0 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy`. If the plan proposes changes, match the differing arguments to DSM and save a new plan.
3. Run `terraform apply adopt.tfplan` once the saved plan contains only the import. The next `terraform plan` should report `No changes`.

## Example configuration

```terraform
resource "synology_network_proxy" "nas" {
  enabled = false
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `authentication_enabled` (Boolean) Authenticate to the proxy. Enabling authentication or changing its username requires an explicit password generation.
- `bypass_local` (Boolean) Bypass the proxy for local addresses.
- `different_https_proxy` (Boolean) Use a different HTTPS proxy. Otherwise HTTP host and port also own the HTTPS values.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable outbound proxy use.
- `http_host` (String) HTTP proxy hostname or IP address, without a URL scheme.
- `http_port` (Number) HTTP proxy port.
- `https_host` (String) HTTPS proxy hostname or IP address.
- `https_port` (Number) HTTPS proxy port.
- `password_version` (Number) Monotonically increasing password generation. Zero preserves the imported credential; external password changes cannot be detected.
- `password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Proxy password; supply with an increased password_version. Omit for adoption. Never stored in plan or state.
- `username` (String) Proxy authentication username.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Singleton identity and import identifier: network_proxy. Destroy only releases Terraform management; it never resets DSM settings.
- `reconciliation_required` (Boolean) An unacknowledged secret mutation requires DSM inspection and explicit management release/import before retry.
